categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Tianmai Thermal Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of thermal management materials and devices. Its main product categories include heat pipes, vapor chambers, thermal interface materials, and graphite films. These products are widely applied in consumer electronics such as smartphones and laptops, as well as in security monitoring equipment, automotive electronics, and communication devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies including powder compounding, surface modification of powders, and flat-head heat pipe processing. It has advanced manufacturing capabilities for ultra-thin heat pipes and vapor chambers with thicknesses as low as 0.3mm and 0.22mm respectively. The company emphasizes automation in production, having internally developed automated production lines and testing equipment, which enhances efficiency and reduces costs. It holds 90 patents, including 16 invention patents, supporting its technological edge.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global and domestic brands such as Samsung, OPPO, Vivo, Huawei, Honor, Lenovo, Asus, NIO, CATL, Hikvision, Dahua, Xiaomi, Panasonic, Kyocera, Logitech, Hisense, BYD, AAC Technologies, Foxconn, and Google. The company serves industries including consumer electronics (smartphones, laptops), security surveillance, automotive electronics, and communication equipment. The markets are driven by rapid product upgrades and emerging technologies like AI, 5G, and electric vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales accounting for about 61% of revenue, and international sales making up about 39%. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Korea and Vietnam, supporting its overseas operations. The company’s products are supplied globally to multinational customers and their supply chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Tianmai operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of thermal management materials and components that are integrated into electronic devices by downstream OEMs and assemblers. It maintains direct sales relationships with end-brand customers and tier-1 suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth, investing heavily in R&D with a 7.38% R&D expense ratio in 2024. Key R&D projects include high heat flux vapor chambers, stainless steel and titanium chemically passivated vapor chambers, composite capillary vapor chamber modules, embedded liquid cooling systems, high integration heat pipe composite radiators, high thermal conductivity graphite films, and silicone-free thermal gels. It aims to enhance product performance, reduce costs, and expand applications in AI, 5G, new energy vehicles, and other emerging fields.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of thermal management materials and devices to electronic manufacturers and system integrators. The company’s income is mainly from product sales, with no indication of subscription or licensing models. It also receives government subsidies and investment income as supplementary revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading thermal management solutions provider with advanced technology and automation capabilities. It competes with international and domestic manufacturers of thermal interface materials and heat dissipation components. Its certifications from top-tier global customers and extensive patent portfolio underscore its competitive standing in the mid-to-high-end market segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 942.9 million, a 1.62% increase over 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 185.4 million, up 20.26%. Total assets grew 60.7% to RMB 1.7 billion, and net assets nearly doubled to RMB 1.5 billion. The company completed its IPO in October 2024, raising over RMB 613 million, which supports its expansion and R&D efforts. The workforce totals 1,753 employees, with 247 in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Tianmai emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, high product quality, and strong automation capabilities to deliver precise and innovative thermal management solutions. Its products offer high thermal conductivity, ultra-thin form factors, and reliable performance tailored to high-power electronic components. The company’s deep integration with leading global brands and its ability to rapidly respond to evolving market demands provide a competitive edge in delivering customized, cost-effective, and scalable thermal solutions.
